commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to ET
commitResults.messageBody: Update the Java entry point, startup banner, and user documentation to use the new chatbot name.
Record intermediate Java and IntelliJ IDEA experience for more appropriately tailored project guidance.

commitResults.messageTitle: Give ET a friendly extraterrestrial personality
commitResults.messageBody: Update the chatbot greeting, prompt, farewell, and setup documentation to match ET's curious space-themed voice.
Give ET a gentle, homesick voice inspired by the film while preserving command echoing and bye handling, and update the setup example to match.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add in-memory task storage and list command

commitResults.messageBody: Add in-memory completion state and support the mark command with task-number validation. Display completion markers in list output and ignore the project-local visual diff skill files.
Support reversing a task's done status with unmark and report the updated task state. Validate task numbers consistently with the existing mark command.
Represent task descriptions and completion state in a dedicated Task class. Delegate status changes and display formatting from ET to Task while preserving the existing task commands.

Represent ToDos, deadlines, and events in a single task model without inheritance, preserving date and time values as strings. Parse the new todo, deadline, and event commands, display type-specific details, and document the updated task syntax.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor task types to use inheritance
commitResults.messageBody: Move shared task state and completion behaviour into the Task base class. Add Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses that render type-specific information, and store them polymorphically in a fixed Task array.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add documented console UI testing workflow
commitResults.messageBody: Create the project-specific test-ui skill and Markdown test plan for exact console-output checks. Require agents to update relevant UI cases and run the skill after each code change, with fail-fast reporting for mismatches.

Introduce ETException for invalid user commands and route task parsing and task-number validation through it. Unknown commands, missing task details, malformed dates, and invalid task references now produce helpful messages without changing the task list or completion state.\n\nAdd interleaved console UI cases that verify invalid deadline and event commands do not create tasks or alter existing task status.

Store tasks in an ArrayList so the task list grows dynamically and the delete command can remove a selected task without manual array shifting. Reuse task-number validation for delete, report the removed task and updated count, and document the resulting console behaviour in the UI test plan.\n\nRecord the CTP workflow so future requests commit, tag using the current Level task name, and push without extra clarification.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce command and task type enums
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize command keywords and task display codes in dedicated enums.\n\nUse CommandType to route input and derive command-specific parsing, and store TaskType in each task so its display code is defined once. Include the project instruction clarifying CP behaviour.

Add project-relative task storage that creates its data directory on demand, restores completion state at startup, and skips malformed records so corrupted files do not prevent launch. Save the list after every successful task-list mutation, expose task fields needed for serialization, document the behavior, and isolate UI test cases from generated storage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add flexible date handling for deadlines and events
commitResults.messageBody: Parse and persist real date-time values while accepting date-only input without leading zeros. Document the Level branch completion procedure.

Move ET's welcome banner, separators, task feedback, and persistence error messages into a dedicated Ui class. This gives the application a single presentation boundary while retaining the existing command flow and exact console output, so later iterations can extract parsing and task-list behavior independently.

Move task creation, date and time validation, required-field checks, and task-number validation from ET into Parser. ET now coordinates application components while Parser owns translating user command text into task objects or validated indices. The console behavior and error messages remain unchanged.

Introduce TaskList as the owner of ET's mutable task collection. Replace direct List operations in ET and Ui with explicit add, lookup, removal, and size operations, and provide immutable snapshots for persistence. This makes task-list responsibilities explicit without changing commands or console output.

Give Ui ownership of the console Scanner and expose hasNextCommand and readCommand methods. ET now interacts with the user exclusively through Ui, which prepares the application loop for command objects while preserving existing input handling and output.

Introduce the Command abstraction and move list display and application exit behavior into ListCommand and ExitCommand. Parser now recognises these no-argument commands and ET executes them polymorphically, while argument-bearing commands remain in ET for the next migration step. Existing console behavior is unchanged.

Move mark and unmark behavior into command classes that share task-index and persistence handling through TaskIndexCommand. Parser now creates the appropriate status command after validating the selected task, and ET delegates execution to it. Add a UI regression case covering both status transitions.

Move task deletion, persistence, and deletion feedback into DeleteCommand, reusing the indexed-task command base. Parser now constructs the command after validating the requested task number, and ET only delegates execution. Add a UI regression case covering deletion and an empty task list.

Introduce AddCommand to add, persist, and report any parsed task, covering todo, deadline, and event commands through one implementation. Move shared task-list persistence handling to Command so all mutating commands use one error-reporting path, and remove ET's final direct save operation.

Refactor ET into an instance-based application with a single read, parse, execute, and error-handling loop. Consolidate parser factories into parseCommand, move task-list bounds validation to indexed commands where the list is available, and allow command execution to report ET exceptions. Add a UI regression case for malformed and unavailable task numbers.
